docs.purpose: Opens one building permit in full after the user taps a card in the feed. It shows the address, an opportunity score, the predicted start date with a best/worst range, the estimated build cost, the projected square footage, the surrounding neighbourhood's income profile, and the description of the work. A bar pinned to the bottom lets the user save the job to their tracked list. If a refresh fails but older data is cached, the old data stays on screen with a warning strip rather than blanking out.
docs.data_story: It reads nothing from the database directly. Every value arrives through 2 contracts: `/api/leads/detail/[id]`, `/api/leads/save`. Behind those contracts, the data comes from `coa_applications`, `cost_estimates`, `entitlements`, `lead_views`, `neighbourhoods`, `permits`, `trade_forecasts` and `user_profiles`, and writes land on `lead_views`. It holds no client-side store, so there is no local copy of server state to keep in sync.
docs.under_126: **REBUILD** — it drives writes, so a client decision has to be re-homed on the server before the projection can be honest. It renders through the DETAIL renderer (one entity, a single-param query key, declared sections), reading by reference: `/api/leads/detail/[id]`, `/api/leads/save`. It owns no component of its own, so its `owns.components[]` is an empty array — a legal answer, written down.

identity.owner: unassigned (no CODEOWNERS file and no owner registry exists in the repo — measured 2026-09-15)

versioning.why: useLeadDetail throws a dedicated LeadDetailSchemaError when is_saved is missing — an explicit deploy-skew tripwire pinned by mobile/__tests__/useLeadDetail.test.ts:109; the response shape cannot lose a field without a client release.

inputs.why: One GET /api/leads/detail/:id supplies every section — cost, square footage, target date, neighbourhood profile and the saved flag; the pre-Spec-99 queryClient cache-walk this screen used instead was removed.

outputs.why: The sticky-CTA heart flips both the ["lead-feed"] pages and the ["lead-detail", id] entry before the POST lands, then invalidates both on settle so a cold-boot deep link and the list agree.
outputs.rollback: useSaveLead onError replays the feed-page snapshot and the lead-detail snapshot captured in onMutate.

state.why: The screen owns no store at all — every value comes from the ["lead-detail", id] cache entry; the only local state is the SaveButton's Reanimated pulse.

staleness.why: useLeadDetail sets a 60-second staleTime and inherits the 24-hour gcTime; on a refetch failure the screen keeps rendering the cached detail behind a "Showing last loaded" banner rather than blanking.

session.why: /api/leads/detail/:id is under the `/api/leads` authenticated prefix and the handler resolves the uid before querying.

rls_class.why: The detail row is pipeline reference data (permits, cost_estimates, neighbourhoods, trade_forecasts) — all Class-B default-deny; only the is_saved lateral touches the Class-A lead_views table.

guards.rate_bucket: none — the lead-detail route calls no withRateLimit

checks.why: mobile/__tests__/useLeadDetail.test.ts parses a well-formed response, asserts percent-encoding of the id segment, and asserts the LeadDetailSchemaError deploy-skew throw.
The key is the single-scalar ["lead-detail", id] the DETAIL archetype requires, and useSaveLead mutates that exact key.
Three distinct renders exist and are testID-tagged: lead-detail-skeleton, lead-detail-not-found and lead-detail-stale-banner ([lead].tsx:126-159).
The screen renders a section only when at least one leaf is non-null, so its rendered field set is a SUBSET of the contract projection — parity is by inspection, not by a generated check.
Five accessibility attributes exist (back button role+label twice, address header role); the SaveButton in the sticky CTA carries a testID but no accessibilityLabel.

errors.why: A first-load failure renders the testID-tagged not-found block; a refetch failure over existing content renders an amber "Showing last loaded — refetch failed." banner instead of discarding the detail.

classes.ui: Not-found block ("This permit is no longer available") — no retry, the id is malformed.
Not-found block; the retry guard deliberately does not burn retries against a throttle.
Retried up to 3 times, then the not-found block (or the stale banner if a cached detail exists).
LeadDetailSchemaError — reported to Sentry, not retried, rendered as the not-found block.

emits.why: lead_detail_viewed fires once per resolved lead and the save toggle fires lead_saved/lead_unsaved from the shared mutation; no ledger row is written because no usage ledger table exists.

offers.why: No sponsored placement is rendered: the only slot component in the Expo tree is SponsorSlot, and it returns null unless EXPO_PUBLIC_PARCEL_SPONSORS=1.

metering.why: Nothing here is counted: the Spec 126 §7 usage ledger table does not exist (grep for usage_events in the introspected drizzle schema returns 0 hits), and the only quota-shaped counter, user_profiles.lead_views_count, is incremented solely by POST /api/leads/view, which has no mobile caller.

config.why: The surface consumes no registered logic variable: the only server-side tunable in this path, user_profiles.radius_cap_km, is a per-user admin column, not a logic_variables row.

sharing.why: /api/leads/detail/:id is exclusive to this surface, but /api/leads/save is rendered by the feed, the flight board and the search sheet, and the same optimistic mutation mirrors into all of them.
sharing.varies_by_surface: Only this surface reads the cost / square-footage / neighbourhood blocks; the feed card projects the ranked-score subset of a different contract.

limitations.what: The sticky save CTA has no accessible label — only a testID.
limitations.measured: [lead].tsx:390-396 passes testID="save-button-detail"; SaveButton.tsx:67-72 sets no accessibilityLabel or accessibilityRole.

limitations.what: CoA leads are declared in the payload type but 404 from the backend, so the lead_type union is effectively single-valued on this screen.
limitations.measured: [lead].tsx:67-70 narrows lead_type to "permit" with an inline comment citing Spec 91 §4.3.1.

limitations.what: The 404 case — which is also how every CoA lead resolves today — cannot be declared: errors.classes has no 404 value.
limitations.measured: surface.schema.json errors.classes enum = 400/401/403/429/500/schema_drift/offline; mobile/__tests__/useLeadDetail.test.ts:148 pins the no-retry-on-404 behaviour that has no descriptor home.

notes: This is the only mobile surface that renders OpportunityRing, so it owns it. SaveButton is rendered here AND inside LeadCard (owned by mobile_lead_feed) — R-13 totality leaves it unowned.

programme.why: Lead generation — the other product. Spec 100 §1 states the parcel tool is "not coupled to the Lead Feed, Flight Center, or LeadDetail"; inventoried only.
